text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a charge discrepancy on a streaming request that invoked a toolcall during a reconnect retry. Charging shows both the partial stream tokens and the toolcall tokens twice. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: Ugh. Can you paste request ids and a short example payload?

maria: Request id: r-9f3a. Sequence: client opened stream -> toolcall invoked at token 120 -> connection dropped -> client reconnected -> stream resumed and toolcall retried. Billing ledger shows: 120 tokens + 80 tool tokens on initial + 80 tool tokens on reconnect. Expected: initial 120 + 80 (tool executed once), reconnect should only bill resumed tokens.

josh: Is the toolcall executed idempotently? i.e. do we attach an idempotency key to the tool RPC? If not, the runtime may treat it as a new toolcall and bill.

maria: We set tool_call.id = "t-9f3a" in payload. Server logs show the tool executed once, but billing entries show two tool charges.

ana: (re: console) Are you seeing provisional vs confirmed charges in the UI? Provisional sometimes displays during resume windows.

maria: Yes — console had a provisional + confirmed pair and they didn't collapse. It looked like duplicate billing to the user.

sam: Quick hypothesis: when stream resumes we create a new session token which creates a provisional ledger entry for the resumed stream prefix, and the toolcall charge is attached both to the original session and to the resumed provisional session because our attribution uses (session_id, call_id) but session_id changed.

josh: That matches something I saw in router logs. We attach charges to the active session token id. If idempotency is tracked on toolcall.id only in the tool executor, ledger attribution could still duplicate if router emits a second attach event for new session.

maria: Repro snippet (sanitized):
```json
{
  "stream_id": "s-abc",
  "session_id": "sess-A",
  "tool_call": { "id": "t-9f3a", "name": "lookup", "args": {} }
}
// on reconnect: session_id -> sess-B, stream resumes with prefix and toolcall re-attach
```

ana: UX ask: can console merge provisional toolcall charges when they share the same tool_call.id and parent request id? Users see duplicates and ping support.

sam: Implementation options: (1) Prevent double attach by routing layer: when resuming, detect tool_call.id already charged for earlier confirmed session and only attach unmatched tokens. (2) Ledger-level dedupe: have billing pipeline dedupe entries by (customer, tool_call.id, time_window). (3) Console-level dedupe for display only (less safe).

josh: (ops) Option 1 seems safest for correctness but requires router change: on resume, query the charge index for that tool_call.id. That adds a lookup on hot path.

maria: Performance tradeoff is ok for rare retries, but we must avoid adding per-resume DB roundtrips for normal short lived streams. Maybe we can memoize in router cache for N seconds.

an a: Also edge: truncation. If client sets max_tokens and server truncates tool output mid-token, we currently bill for full token count produced before truncation, but when reconciling with resume we sometimes double-count partial token fragments as separate tokens. Need to standardize: bill by token boundaries we emit to client, not internal fragments.

sam: Agreed. Action items: (a) instrument a quick trace for r-9f3a to show events: initial attach, tool_exec, ledger_emit, reconnect_attach, ledger_emit. (b) proposal PR to router to check a small in-memory recent-toolcall cache keyed by (customer, tool_call.id) before emitting attach on resume. (c) console change to hide provisional duplicate until confirmed.

maria: I'll grab traces and paste. Also filing a short postmortem if it's customer-facing.

billing-bot: Billing pipeline alert: potential duplicate toolcall charge pattern detected (threshold crossed). Ticket: BILL-4921

sam: Thanks. If billing pipeline can mark potential dupes we can reconcile quicker. Put the patch in draft, we'll review.

josh: One more: ensure metrics include "attach_emitted:bool" and "attach_deduped:bool" so we can dashboard how often resume triggers duplicate attach.

maria: Noted. I'll add to trace and link dashboard card.

ana: Quick console UX note: change label from "provisional" to "provisional (may merge with earlier charges)" to reduce support tickets. Small copy change but helps.

maria: Ok thanks all — I'll follow up with traces + ticket link. :thumbsup:
